grievances.title: Deep Hazardous Pothole near Main Market Crossing
grievances.description: A very large pothole (over 1.5 feet deep) has formed right at the busy traffic intersection. Two two-wheelers skidded yesterday evening. Immediate resurfacing required before accidents happen.
grievances.address: Opposite Gurudwara Road, Near Main Market Crossing, Civil Lines
grievances.routingReason: Auto-routed to Roads Dept based on detected tokens: 'pothole', 'resurfacing', 'traffic'. Priority set to HIGH due to public safety risk near busy crossing.

resolution.summary: Cold mix asphalt resurfacing completed, compacted with vibratory roller. Traffic flow restored smoothly.
resolution.materialsUsed: Bituminous cold mix (450 kg), tack coat, stone grit

feedback.comment: Super fast action by Pooja Hegde and the civil road crew! Repaired within 22 hours.

grievances.title: Large Neem Tree Branch Snapped, Hanging on Power Cable
grievances.description: Due to heavy thunderstorms yesterday, a huge tree branch broke and is suspended precariously on the 440V distribution lines. High risk of cable snapping and short circuit.

grievances.routingReason: Keywords: 'tree branch snapped', 'power cable', 'short circuit'. Multi-department flag: Parks (primary) with safety notice to Electrical.

resolution.summary: Coordinated with electrical team for temporary 30-min power shutdown. Hydraulic crane and chainsaw team safely pruned snapped branches and cleared debris.
resolution.materialsUsed: Hydraulic sky-lift truck, chainsaw crew, green waste compactor

feedback.comment: Very prompt and professional work by the urban forestry team. The branch was cleared safely.
